title: B2010 - B2010
engines: Tüm VAG Benzinli (TSI/TFSI) ve Dizel (TDI) Motorlar
stepByStepSolution:
Perform Basic Setting
See Vehicle specific Diagnostic Procedures for Details
See Vehicle specific Diagnostic Procedures for Details
technicalNotes:
When found in the VW Touareg (7P) Trunk Electronics 6D control module perform the Rear Lid relearn.
When found in the VW Touareg (7P) Parking Brake 53 control module review the following forum post:
https://forums.ross-tech.com/showthread.php?23560
When found in the BA-Motor Mounts (J931) control module (typically in conjunction with B2005) on  4G Chassis S6/S7/RS7 with 4.0T engine see:
NAR (North American) Market TPI 2036392
https://static.nhtsa.gov/odi/tsbs/2017/MC-10128212-9999.pdf  NHTSA
2013-2015 S6/S7/RS7/A8/R8 with 4.0T engine
RoW (Rest of World) Market TPI 2036309
Those TPIs discuss Audi SVM code BAA001 for the flash update in addition to a mechanical adjustment and Basic Setting procedure. The RoW document includes the S8 model.
When found in an UDS EPB system, perform Temel Ayarları (Basic Settings) Yapın:  [*IDE03407-MAS00478*].  This may be labeled Start of operations -or- Initiation but the Identifier should not change.
When found in RoW market UDS protocol 17-Instrument clusters, check the service related Adaptasyon / Kalibrasyon Yapın:  channels.  This thread should add clarity: https://forums.ross-tech.com/showthread.php?1874-Audi-Q3-fault-code-1048578-No-Basic-Setting
